description: A stone-edged sickle. It is heavy in the hand and the edge has a fine grit, like sand. It cuts grass cleanly if you hold it right, but the stone chips if you strike a twig. It is not as fast as a metal blade. For a week, it has been the only thing I use to harvest.
role_link_note: The Farmer's harvest work needs a cutting edge — a river stone knapped and hafted on sticks brings the festival week's grain in.
